_description: Cross-version module renames and merges, one block per OpenUpgrade branch N.0: renamed_modules / merged_modules of that branch's apriori.py (old name at N-1 -> new name at N). GENERATED - do not edit by hand: python scripts/sync_module_renames.py --write (weekly workflow module-renames-resync.yml opens a PR on drift).
_oracle: ADR-0055 provenance + oracle. Provenance: each branch block records repo, branch, commit and path of the apriori.py it was parsed from (ast.literal_eval, never executed). Oracle: the read side (src/indexer/module_renames.resolve_chain) shows an edge only when the caller's index has old at N-1 and not from N to the asked version, and new at N; chains are composed hop by hop under the same rule.
